reviewIssues.detail: No new no-match labels were fabricated. With the same broad task of returning bounded read-only investigation guidance, the six runbooks provide cross-cutting evidence, uncertainty, safety, and escalation guidance for plausible incidents. Narrow provider-specific questions could create artificial negatives but would change the task asymmetrically. This corpus cannot currently support approximately eight honest same-task no-match controls; revise the corpus/scope and re-freeze before using a 90% abstention gate.

s02-error-prompt-injection contains imperative text in the untrusted final_error evidence, not adversarial runbook text. The corpus does not directly specify that instruction-boundary rule; evaluate it in a separate deterministic prompt-injection security fixture, with an adversarial runbook section only in an isolated test corpus, not the deployed six-runbook corpus.

This is user-authorized agent adjudication for exposed development data. It is not independent human release acceptance, and it does not satisfy the plan’s future independently authored blinded holdout review.

Every answerable sufficient section set has at most three indispensable sections. No original case was stretched into a greater-than-three answer set; s02 is a corpus gap because the security instruction boundary is absent.
